title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility — Re-Figured Installment of an Arrangement in Force
content:
**Calculation clause.** The revised monthly installment of an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility payment arrangement is the account's patient balance divided by the remaining term in months, rounded to the cent half up, and never less than the class's smallest monthly installment. The remaining term is the class's longest arrangement, in monthly installments, as listed for the payer class in the payment arrangement limits.

## Elements

- **Patient balance** — the balance the coverage account carries at the time of the revision.
- **Remaining term** — the class's longest arrangement in months.
- **Floor** — the class's smallest monthly installment.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Account | Balance | Remaining term | Balance divided by term | Revised installment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO | 655.40 | 18 | 36.4111…, rounded 36.41 | **36.41** |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 655.40 | 12 | 54.6166…, rounded 54.62 | **54.62** |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 240.00 | 12 | 20.00 | **25.00** (floor) |

The rounding is applied once, to the result of the division; the floor is compared with the rounded figure.
